## Sallie Awards $500,000 in Scholarships to Help Students Advance Their Education and Career Goals


11/04/2026


Download this Press Release PDF Format (opens in new window)


*The Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program Provides $10,000 Scholarships to 30 High School Seniors and 20 Graduate Students Nationwide*


NEWARK, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


In celebration of National Scholarship Month, Sallie today announced the newest recipients of its Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program. The Sallie Mae Fund, in partnership with the Thurgood Marshall College Fund (TMCF), awarded $500,000 in scholarships to help students access and complete higher education.


Through this year’s program,[30 high school seniors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Flanding%2Fbridging-the-dream%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=30+high+school+seniors&index=1&md5=59feb73b77a59c66c1aea3879de67980) received $10,000 scholarships based on financial need, academic achievement, leadership, and service. In addition,[20 graduate students](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Flanding%2Fbridging-the-dream-for-graduates%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=20+graduate+students&index=2&md5=3a5419ece797adbd4647ed2ab433b785) pursuing advanced degrees also received $10,000 scholarships.


Since 2021,[The Sallie Mae Fund](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Fabout%2Fscholarship-opportunities%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Sallie+Mae+Fund&index=3&md5=2be2ad513993358e35d8b9f87941f880) has awarded more than $5.5 million in scholarships to nearly 1,500 students through its[Bridging the Dream](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Fabout%2Fscholarship-opportunities%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Bridging+the+Dream&index=4&md5=44acf00495f9fc7f10d498b917f39749) and[Completing the Dream Scholarship Programs](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Flanding%2Fcompleting-the-dream%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Completing+the+Dream+Scholarship+Programs&index=5&md5=3ab165bab1cd15e3864be2f926dba70f) .


"Making higher education more accessible and affordable means helping students and families use every resource available to them, and scholarships are a critical part of that," said Nicolas Jafarieh, Executive Vice President, Sallie. "The Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program is one way we're helping remove financial barriers and supporting students on their path to a degree."


For Makenzie Hill, a criminal justice student at Clark Atlanta University, the scholarship helps her pursue her goal of serving and advocating for others in her community. "It is a reminder that there are people who believe in students like me and are willing to invest in their futures," said Hill. "I hope to use my education to stand up for those whose voices have often been overlooked."


"When we invest in students, we invest in the leaders, professionals, and changemakers of tomorrow," said Dr. Harry L. Williams, President and CEO, Thurgood Marshall College Fund. "Our partnership with The Sallie Mae Fund helps students continue their education and put their talents to work in their communities."

**How Sallie Supports Students From College Planning to Graduation** In addition to the[Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Fabout%2Fscholarship-opportunities%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Bridging+the+Dream+Scholarship+Program&index=6&md5=edc532c0e3530d09d133891c8cd37a4c) ,[Sallie](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sallie.com%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Sallie&index=7&md5=a8ed90a1565fd8ac68564dee0aeee9c5) offers free tools, resources, and other scholarship opportunities to help students and families plan and pay for higher education, including:


- [Scholly® Scholarships ,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sallie.com%2Fscholarships%2Fscholly%3Futm_source%3Dslmcom%26utm_medium%3Dweb%26utm_content%3Dfooter%26_gl%3D1*1ivq1li*_gcl_au*MTY4MzUwNzE2My4xNzkyNDA4MDEz&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Scholly%26%23174%3B+Scholarships%2C&index=8&md5=36251ce505b44d1ee079597a3f27139e) to find and apply for scholarships.
- [Scout® College Search](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sallie.com%2Fcolleges%2Fsearch&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Scout%26%23174%3B+College+Search&index=9&md5=b5a410290358a9f113ba02690373176f) , to explore and compare colleges.
- **A**[college savings guide](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Fresources%2Fsavings%2Fsavings-guide%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=college+savings+guide&index=10&md5=294d0563991af281c596db69c3913e7e) , to plan and save.
- **A**[step-by-step FAFSA® Guide](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sallie.com%2Ffinancial-aid%2Ffafsa%2Fguide&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=step-by-step+FAFSA%26%23174%3B+Guide&index=11&md5=330887641717c16ef2eed0cc60c68579) , to navigate financial aid.
- **The Sallie Mae Fund's**[Completing the Dream Scholarship Program](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Flanding%2Fcompleting-the-dream%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=Completing+the+Dream+Scholarship+Program&index=12&md5=42706189d701137b47c138270f8b16c5) , to help students facing financial challenges stay on track to graduation.


To learn more about the Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program, visit[https://www.salliemae.com/about/scholarship-opportunities/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Fabout%2Fscholarship-opportunities%2F&esheet=54633685&newsitemid=20261102015178&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.salliemae.com%2Fabout%2Fscholarship-opportunities%2F&index=13&md5=6a9080fb461883e60453bf7e709ab974) .
